{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = '/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv'
df = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Remove QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
df_clean = df[df['revenue_clean'] != 999999.99].copy()

# Remove refunded orders (status == 'refunded')
df_clean = df_clean[df_clean['status'] == 'completed'].copy()

# Now check the two main groups: email vs paid_search
# Check if channel is balanced across customer_segment
print("Cross-tabulation of channel vs customer_segment:")
print(pd.crosstab(df_clean['channel'], df_clean['customer_segment']))

# Check conversion rates by channel
conv_rate_email = df_clean[df_clean['channel'] == 'email']['converted'].mean()
conv_rate_paid_search = df_clean[df_clean['channel'] == 'paid_search']['converted'].mean()

print(f"Conversion rate (email): {conv_rate_email:.4f}")
print(f"Conversion rate (paid_search): {conv_rate_paid_search:.4f}")
print(f"Difference (email - paid_search): {conv_rate_email - conv_rate_paid_search:.4f}")"}
